facts.fact: Daniel 回到 Agency 之后，Lucy 每夜都睡不好，反复梦见无尽走廊、接待台后面的幻灵，以及 CEO 那抹过于洁白的笑容。
facts.anchor: Sleep is elusive after Daniel returns to the Agency.

facts.fact: 第二天之后，两人之间那条由联结构成的无形通道彻底消失，她再也无法隔着它确认他是否安好。
facts.anchor: after the second day without him, the invisible pathway that made up our connection is simply gone

facts.fact: Agency 给她的报酬不是钱，而是更长的寿命，以及（理论上）Daniel 的自由；这种报酬付不了房租。
facts.anchor: My compensation is fabulous, but it comes entirely in the form of a longer lifespan for me and—in theory, at least—freedom for Daniel.

facts.fact: 她在招聘启事上看到的雇主是 Frederick 和 Cassie Fitzwilliam，一对总是出门旅行的雇主。
这份「每月看一次房子」的差事，每次报酬一万美元，另加交通费；她随即怀疑这些人多到离谱的财富。
facts.anchor: Salary: $10,000 per visit, plus commuting expenses

facts.fact: 她对 Jess 只承认自己接的是一份兼职、待遇优厚、要拍照片的活儿，属于某家小型机构的调研项目。
facts.anchor: All she knows is it’s a part-time arrangement with excellent benefits where I’ll be taking photos as part of a niche agency’s research project.

facts.fact: 她早就买好法国烹饪课当作婚礼礼物送给 Jess，只是一直没说；Jess 自己也想报名同一门课。
facts.anchor: Because I already got you French cooking classes. As a just-for-Jess wedding gift.

facts.fact: Daniel 出现在咖啡店时，她确认 Agency 兑现了承诺——改造确实成功了。
facts.anchor: The Agency made good on their promise. And it worked.

facts.fact: 结尾他吻了回去，说她是他的，而且永远都是。
facts.anchor: “Yours,” he agrees as he kisses me back. “Always.”
